mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and stock valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 110), supply chain disruptions and reduced manufacturing output lead to higher input costs and lower corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 110, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly growth in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates a strengthening economy that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with positive GDPC1 growth, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate indicates a monetary tightening cycle amid economic weakness, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market boom (HOUST > 1800 thousand units), strong residential construction activity boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1800, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.04.
